sentence: On the whole, I enjoyed the trip.
zh-TW: 整體來說，我很喜歡這趟旅行。

sentence: Would you care to join us for dinner?
zh-TW: 你想跟我們一起吃晚餐嗎？

sentence: The plan takes account of everyone's needs.
zh-TW: 這個計畫考慮到了每個人的需求。

sentence: He said he was sick, or something like that.
zh-TW: 他說他生病了，之類的。

sentence: Make use of the free time you have.
zh-TW: 好好利用你的空閒時間。

sentence: When it comes to cooking, Tom is the best.
zh-TW: 說到做菜，Tom 是最厲害的。

sentence: Please fill in this form.
zh-TW: 請填寫這張表格。
tagging_notes: fill in 在此為「填寫」

sentence: For all its problems, I love this city.
zh-TW: 儘管有種種問題，我還是愛這座城市。
tagging_notes: for all 在此為「儘管」

sentence: It's just a question of time.
zh-TW: 這只是時間的問題。

sentence: They became friends for life.
zh-TW: 他們成了一輩子的朋友。

sentence: I need to get away for a few days.
zh-TW: 我需要出去走走幾天。
tagging_notes: get away 在此為「離開；擺脫（日常）」

sentence: Dinner's almost ready. In the meantime, set the table.
zh-TW: 晚餐快好了，你先擺一下餐具。

sentence: She's something of an expert on wine.
zh-TW: 她算是個葡萄酒專家。
tagging_notes: 句中為 something of an（母音前）

sentence: I have the odd glass of wine on weekends.
zh-TW: 我週末偶爾會喝杯葡萄酒。

sentence: The village is little more than a few houses.
zh-TW: 那個村子不過就是幾間房子而已。

sentence: Would you like some help with that?
zh-TW: 需要我幫你嗎？

sentence: We collect clothes for families in need.
zh-TW: 我們為有需要的家庭募集衣物。

sentence: Good health is something we often take for granted.
zh-TW: 健康常常被我們視為理所當然。

sentence: In this respect, the two phones are the same.
zh-TW: 在這方面，兩支手機是一樣的。

sentence: You can borrow my car, provided that you drive carefully.
zh-TW: 只要你小心開車，就可以借我的車。

sentence: Allow for an extra hour in traffic.
zh-TW: 要多預留一小時給塞車。
tagging_notes: allow for 在此為「將…考慮在內」

sentence: You go ahead. I'll catch up later.
zh-TW: 你先走，我等一下跟上。

sentence: Can I have a go on your bike?
zh-TW: 我可以試騎一下你的腳踏車嗎？
tagging_notes: a go 在此為「嘗試一下」

sentence: For the moment, we'll stay at a hotel.
zh-TW: 我們暫時先住飯店。

sentence: Don't work at the expense of your health.
zh-TW: 別犧牲健康去工作。

sentence: It took an hour to put together the shelf.
zh-TW: 組裝這個架子花了一個小時。
tagging_notes: put together 在此為「組合；組裝」

sentence: I like hiking, camping and things like that.
zh-TW: 我喜歡健行、露營之類的活動。

sentence: The old map was of little use.
zh-TW: 那張舊地圖沒什麼用處。

sentence: Shut up and listen for a second.
zh-TW: 安靜一下，聽我說。
tagging_notes: 口語，語氣強烈，對熟人使用

sentence: As of Monday, the office opens at nine.
zh-TW: 從週一起，辦公室九點開門。

sentence: Your English will improve over time.
zh-TW: 你的英文會隨著時間進步。

sentence: It would appear that we're lost.
zh-TW: 看來我們好像迷路了。

sentence: I saw your brother the other day.
zh-TW: 我前幾天看到你哥哥。

sentence: In theory, the trip takes two hours.
zh-TW: 理論上，這趟車程要兩小時。

sentence: She's thought of as the best teacher here.
zh-TW: 她被認為是這裡最好的老師。

sentence: He's moving to Canada for good.
zh-TW: 他要永久搬去加拿大了。

sentence: Many people are opposed to the new rule.
zh-TW: 很多人反對新規定。

sentence: Use your common sense.
zh-TW: 用你的常識判斷一下。

sentence: He didn't even bother to say goodbye.
zh-TW: 他連再見都懶得說。

sentence: The car is as good as new.
zh-TW: 這台車跟新的差不多。
tagging_notes: as good as 在此為「幾乎等於；就像」

sentence: Always back up your files.
zh-TW: 一定要備份你的檔案。
tagging_notes: back up 在此為「備份」

sentence: Can you take care of my cat this weekend?
zh-TW: 這個週末你可以幫我照顧貓嗎？

sentence: I can't stand the sight of blood.
zh-TW: 我看到血就受不了。

sentence: Is there enough cake to go round?
zh-TW: 蛋糕夠大家分嗎？
tagging_notes: go round 在此為「足夠分配」

sentence: I forgot the whole thing.
zh-TW: 我把整件事都忘了。

sentence: At one time, this street was full of shops.
zh-TW: 這條街曾經到處都是商店。

sentence: We're heading to the airport now.
zh-TW: 我們現在正要去機場。
tagging_notes: 句中為 heading to

sentence: In a sense, you're right.
zh-TW: 從某種意義上說，你是對的。

sentence: On average, I sleep seven hours a night.
zh-TW: 我平均每晚睡七小時。

sentence: You're holding the map the wrong way round.
zh-TW: 你把地圖拿反了。
tagging_notes: way round 在此為「方向」

sentence: I can tell you're tired.
zh-TW: 我看得出來你累了。

sentence: This food is free from nuts.
zh-TW: 這種食物不含堅果。

sentence: We talked about school, work and all that.
zh-TW: 我們聊了學校、工作之類的事。

sentence: He's the boss of the house, as it were.
zh-TW: 他可以說是家裡的老大。

sentence: What if it rains tomorrow?
zh-TW: 如果明天下雨怎麼辦？

sentence: Add a touch of salt.
zh-TW: 加一點點鹽。

sentence: You'd be better off taking the train.
zh-TW: 你搭火車會比較好。

sentence: What does this sign stand for?
zh-TW: 這個標誌代表什麼？

sentence: Nobody is to blame for the accident.
zh-TW: 這場意外不能怪任何人。

sentence: The bulk of my salary goes on rent.
zh-TW: 我大部分的薪水都花在房租上。

sentence: Only a handful of people came.
zh-TW: 只有少數幾個人來。

sentence: Make the rules clear at the outset.
zh-TW: 一開始就把規則講清楚。

sentence: She got the job by virtue of her experience.
zh-TW: 她憑藉經驗得到這份工作。

sentence: She turned down the job offer.
zh-TW: 她拒絕了那份工作邀約。
tagging_notes: turn down 在此為「拒絕」

sentence: I get on well with my roommate.
zh-TW: 我跟室友處得很好。
tagging_notes: get on 在此為「相處」

sentence: Work on the new station is under way.
zh-TW: 新車站的工程正在進行中。

sentence: In the interest of safety, please stay seated.
zh-TW: 為了安全起見，請保持就座。

sentence: Their house has been on the market for months.
zh-TW: 他們的房子已經掛牌出售好幾個月了。

sentence: This is by far the best cafe in town.
zh-TW: 這絕對是城裡最棒的咖啡店。

sentence: The job requires a degree of patience.
zh-TW: 這份工作需要一定程度的耐心。

sentence: Never mind, I'll do it myself.
zh-TW: 沒關係，我自己來。

sentence: He walked up and down the hall.
zh-TW: 他在走廊上走來走去。

sentence: She's a famous singer in her own right.
zh-TW: 她本身就是知名歌手。

sentence: It's a case of too much work and too little sleep.
zh-TW: 這是工作太多、睡眠太少的情況。

sentence: The test was hard, and more so for beginners.
zh-TW: 考試很難，對初學者來說更是如此。

sentence: The food didn't come up to our expectations.
zh-TW: 食物沒有達到我們的期望。

sentence: It may rain, in which case we'll stay home.
zh-TW: 可能會下雨，那樣的話我們就待在家。

sentence: There's still no sign of the bus.
zh-TW: 公車還是不見蹤影。

sentence: The phone rang just as I was leaving.
zh-TW: 我正要出門時電話響了。
tagging_notes: just as 在此為「正當…時」

sentence: Let's stay calm for the sake of the kids.
zh-TW: 為了孩子，我們保持冷靜吧。

sentence: I'm not in a position to decide.
zh-TW: 我沒有權限做決定。

sentence: We'll remember this trip for years to come.
zh-TW: 未來好幾年我們都會記得這趟旅行。
tagging_notes: to come 在此為「未來的」

sentence: The plan is backed by the whole team.
zh-TW: 這個計畫得到全隊的支持。

sentence: The food was average at best.
zh-TW: 那裡的食物充其量只算普通。

sentence: She has a wealth of experience.
zh-TW: 她有豐富的經驗。

sentence: I like reading, painting, that sort of thing.
zh-TW: 我喜歡閱讀、畫畫那類的事。

sentence: I can't make out what the sign says.
zh-TW: 我看不清楚那個標誌寫什麼。
tagging_notes: make out 在此為「辨認出」

sentence: He's still trying to come to terms with the news.
zh-TW: 他還在努力接受這個消息。

sentence: I'm very fond of my grandmother.
zh-TW: 我非常喜歡我的奶奶。

sentence: He's saving money with a view to buying a car.
zh-TW: 他在存錢，打算買車。

sentence: It's getting dark. Let's turn back.
zh-TW: 天快黑了，我們回頭吧。

sentence: You won't get away with lying to me.
zh-TW: 你騙我是騙不過去的。

sentence: No wonder you're tired. You didn't sleep!
zh-TW: 難怪你累了，你都沒睡！

sentence: Exercise is good for your well-being.
zh-TW: 運動對你的身心健康有益。

sentence: How about going out for lunch?
zh-TW: 出去吃午餐怎麼樣？

sentence: We have two days to go before the trip.
zh-TW: 離出發還剩兩天。
tagging_notes: to go 在此為「剩下的」

sentence: I'll call you back straight away.
zh-TW: 我馬上回電給你。

sentence: The flight was delayed owing to bad weather.
zh-TW: 班機因天氣不佳而延誤。

sentence: Sorry I'm late. I was held up in traffic.
zh-TW: 抱歉我遲到了，我被塞車耽擱了。
tagging_notes: hold up 在此為「耽擱」

sentence: Kids look to their parents for help.
zh-TW: 孩子會指望父母幫忙。
tagging_notes: look to 在此為「指望」
